about: Belarusian-American entrepreneur, author, and media personality, known for growing his family's wine business into an early e-commerce and online-video success before founding VaynerMedia, a digital and social media marketing agency. Already covered in the book library via Crushing It!

quotes.text: An entrepreneur is someone who finds a way.
A strong personal brand is your ticket to complete personal and professional freedom.
There's no secret to being successful on the Internet. You need to be good at what you do; you need to be passionate about it and go crush it.
Your intent will be reflected in your authenticity.
If you're seeking to build your audience, go where the audience goes, wherever that may lead.
